title: The Insanity Crawler
summary: The Insanity Crawler summons mind worms when it kills a player or pet.
overview: The Insanity Crawler summons mind worms when it kills a player or pet.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Keep players and pets alive to limit the number of mind worms.
Have an add tank ready to collect four worms when a kill triggers them.
The crawler has a limited appearance window, so assemble before engaging.
